_comment: Which fixtures in this directory are a recording of the real read API, and which are hand-written. Read by BOTH `generate.js` (which writes the generated ones) and `fixtures.test.ts` (which asserts they still match). One list, two consumers, so neither side can gain a fixture the other does not know about. A JSON file cannot carry a `# kit:` marker the way a corpus can, so membership is declared here instead — with a reason, never as a bare filename.

generated.why: the list every corpus in the directory appears in — the fixture a new project changes
a real app's full projection, with every sharedWith empty
a real app's full projection whose nouns ARE shared, so sharedWith is exercised

handWritten.why: not a recording of anything — it is one half of a contract pinned from both sides, by ui/src/api/client.test.ts and by prototypes/behaviour-ast/kit.test.js. Regenerating it would delete the pin.
